title: particle.c: fn_80393C14 and hsd_80394434 are policy blockers - do not re-attempt exact
applies_when: The target symbol is fn_80393C14 or hsd_80394434 in src/sysdolphin/baselib/particle.c.
A worker is asked to close the remaining gap on particle.c data pooling.
summary: fn_80393C14 (gate-clean ceiling 99.77143) and hsd_80394434 (94.17647, objdiff-cli) need per-function '#pragma pool_data off' - the original source provably had it - and pragmas are banned. This is a maintainer decision, not an agent-effort target. TU-wide pool_data off regresses sibling functions that DO pool.
do: Leave both functions at their gate-clean baselines and report the blocker instead of iterating.
Compare scores same-tool only (objdiff-cli vs objdiff-cli); report and diff disagree on partial matches.
do_not: Re-attempt exact on fn_80393C14 or hsd_80394434 with source shapes, weak tricks, or TU-wide pooling changes.
Add string-literal blobs to force .data layout (maintainer rejection precedent pr2659-particle-string-blob-resubmission).
superseded_by: maintainer decision to allow per-function pragma pool_data

do_not: Re-attempt exact on grGreens_80214FA8 or grGreens_802166C4.

title: Gate-exact-tail targets: check config metadata first, then naming, headers, MWCC idioms
applies_when: A worker reached exact (or near-exact) but QA gates rejected the attempt, or the residual is relocation/data metadata rather than instructions.
An exact attempt seems to need a banned pragma, #define alias, extern-in-.c, or address-named data.
summary: The 2026-07 out-of-band fleet repaired 42 stuck gate-exact-tail targets; the same failure classes recur. In checking order: (1) config metadata, not source (~40%): symbols.txt extents (NULs, pad bytes), scope:global vs @NNN scope:local literals, wrong-TU data attribution, missing TU split (MWCC's merged-data anchor is always at .data+0 - a retail anchor elsewhere proves a separate TU); (2) name evidenced data semantically across .c/.static.h/symbols.txt; (3) retype the owning header truthfully instead of alias/K&R tricks; (4) sanctioned MWCC idioms: if(0) statement padding beats the 14-statement auto-inline threshold, __declspec(weak) breaks >=3-object data pooling, inline u16-returning helpers reproduce argument truncation, real jobj.h inlines emit exact assert strings, anonymous pooled literals are value-equal under functionRelocDiffs=data_value.
do: Check symbols.txt/splits.txt truth (extents, scope, TU attribution) before reshaping source.
Verify literal VALUES against raw section bytes before assuming an ordering problem.
Use same-tool objdiff comparisons only, and re-check neighbors per-function after inline/pooling changes.
do_not: Ship #pragma, #define rename aliases, extern-in-.c, K&R decls, or address-named data to force a match.
Add .sdata2 anchor consts for literal order (value-equal under data_value).
Re-attempt exact on the four documented policy blockers (particle fn_80393C14/hsd_80394434, grgreens grGreens_80214FA8/grGreens_802166C4).
superseded_by: current source, headers, assembly, objdiff, and regression output
